sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety, returning nine dated official candidates and recommending this agent-skill security paper.
Main agent read the full arXiv paper, extracted method, formulas, benchmark tables, marketplace scan results, and limitations.
Related work search checked malicious skill empirical studies, SKILL.md supply-chain attacks, SkillSpector, Snyk ToxicSkills, and OWASP Agentic Skills references.
Article uses pure Markdown with TL;DR, tables, formula explanations, pseudocode, Mermaid, and explicit evidence boundaries.
